title: Loading spaces (serving another property)
text:
20.10.330 Loading spaces (serving another property).
A.	Any otherwise permitted use for which the loading requirements of Chapter 20.14 are to be satisfied by loading spaces on property which is located within two hundred fifty feet of the property requiring the loading spaces.
B.	Loading spaces serving another property which are located partially or totally within two hundred fifty feet of the property requiring the loading spaces.
(Ord. 16653 § 2 (part), 2007)
